displayName: Nextier Titanium Substage Index Sept3 V1
description: The THIRD TITANIUM STAGE TIER -- stage windows, not substage labels. Coarse titanium stages re-bound to the substage landmarks sapphire placed: start is open_well when placed and the coarse start otherwise, end is close_well when placed and the coarse end otherwise. Pad, slurry and the stage_start/stage_end landmarks deliberately do NOT move these boundaries. Named in the titanium family because its rows are stage windows and it renders as a layer on the stage dashboard beside titanium_first and titanium_final; the sept3 vintage marks the sapphire run that refined it. Derived from the sapphire stage summary, never computed independently.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_uid, fleet_name AS fleet_name, pad_name AS pad_name, name AS well_name, id AS well_id, api_num AS api_num, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS titanium_stage_uid, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS sapphire_stage_uid, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS coarse_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS coarse_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS start_src, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS end_src, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_source, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS run_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS processed_at FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0

well_id.description: Well id from the source stream.

stage_num.description: Stage ordinal, shared with the coarse titanium index.

titanium_stage_uid.description: Coarse titanium stage index row this refines.

sapphire_stage_uid.description: Sapphire stage summary row that supplied the landmarks.

coarse_start_ts.description: Titanium window start this refined from, kept so the shift is auditable rather than implied.

coarse_end_ts.description: Titanium window end this refined from.

stage_source.description: Titanium split that supplied the coarse window.

algorithm_version.description: Sapphire algorithm version that refined it.

run_id.description: Workflow run that wrote the row.
